items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: It wouldn't have been my uncle because he died as a youngster.

ctx.x: Yeah, Harry finally went with Earl Hines.
But there is a William Williams listed in that AFM list -- it's not the same one.

It wouldn't have been my uncle because he died as a youngster. And I remember going to the barber shop, everybody worked in the barber shop. In fact my grandmother had this barber shop and everybody worked in it and she had the girls work in the barber shop, too. They shaved the men and I think that's where my father met my mother, you know, working in the barber shop and they finally got married. I remember going to the barber shop
